auto_mode.description: Enables automatic door control and the click-bot at the end of the print.

settings.title: System Settings
settings.description: Configure printer connection, hardware ports, and material profiles here.

bot.title: Bot Click Sequence
bot.description: Create as many clicks as needed. Press "Capture" and move the mouse to the desired screen position within 3 seconds.
bot.capture_instruction: Switch to Bambu Studio, position your mouse and press F8
bot.notification_body: The click coordinates have been successfully saved.
bot.capture_success_body: The coordinates have been successfully applied.
bot.info_fullscreen: Bambu Studio should always be opened in fullscreen mode on your primary monitor.
bot.info_taskbar: The Bambu Studio icon must always remain in the exact same position on your taskbar.
bot.info_scaling: If you change your monitor or adjust the Windows display scaling (text size), you must re-learn the click positions.
bot.info_taskbar_hide: The Windows taskbar must not be set to 'Auto-hide', as this will shift the click positions.
bot.multi_seq_desc: Create multiple sequences that the bot executes for each new print.
bot.seq_min_error: At least one sequence must exist!

gcode.title: End-Gcode Generator
gcode.description: Generate the code for automatic ejection. Paste it into the slicer's Machine End G-code.

temps.title: Temperatures
temps.why_no_buffer_text: No 5°C buffer is needed here, as the mechanical push command follows immediately. Set the exact temperature at which the material releases reliably.

position.title: Push Position
position.center_text: Aim exactly for the center of gravity of your part. This prevents the print from rotating or jamming while pushing. (Bed center = 128)
position.plastic_info: Use the plastic, not the nozzle
position.plastic_text: This is the distance between the nozzle tip and the print bed. Choose a height so that ideally the solid plastic housing of the print head pushes the part, not the delicate nozzle itself!

instruction.title: Where does the code go?
instruction.text: Insert the generated code exactly before the following block in the Machine End G-code:

hook.z_down_desc: The Z-height the bed is lowered to build pressure on the plate.
hook.z_up_desc: The Z-height the bed is raised back to relax.
hook.warning_height_desc: Decrease the maximum printable height in the printer settings by the exact length of the mounted hooks.
hook.warning_startcode_desc: Warning: Changing the 'Printable height' often DOES NOT automatically change hardcoded values in the Start G-code! Check the Machine Start G-code for Z-limit commands (like 'G28 Z P0 T...') and reduce them manually by the hook length, otherwise the bed will crash during homing!
